function_v0.doc:
One-time initialisation.  Reverts if called again.

Parameters
- `passkey_admin`: Zion1 PasskeyID smart-wallet address.
- `lobstr_admin`:  Distinct Lobstr G-address.
- `reward_token`: Zi SAC address (reward currency).
- `lp_token`:     Zi/XLM LP pool-share token address (staking asset).
**Immutable** \xe2\x80\x94 cannot be changed after init.
function_v0.name: init

function_v0.doc: Claim all pending Zi rewards without unstaking.\n\n**Not blocked by pause** \xe2\x80\x94 claim is always available as an exit path.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc:
Stake `amount` LP tokens.

Each call (re)sets the unlock timestamp to `now + LOCK_PERIOD`.
Accrued rewards up to this point are snapshotted into `pending_rewards`
so they are not lost.

Reverts if:
- Contract is paused.
- Amount \xe2\x89\xa4 0.
- The contract's actual Zi balance is insufficient to honour outstanding
reward obligations at the current rate (solvency gate).
function_v0.name: stake

function_v0.doc:
Withdraw all staked LP tokens.  Auto-claims pending rewards.

**Not blocked by pause** \xe2\x80\x94 unstake is always available as an exit path.
Reverts if the lock period has not yet expired.
function_v0.name: unstake

function_v0.doc:
Extend the contract instance and an existing staker position to the
configured TTL target. Anyone may call this method so an operations
keeper can preserve one-year locked positions without holding user or
admin credentials. It cannot create or modify a staking balance.
function_v0.name: keep_alive

function_v0.doc:
Pause or unpause the contract.  Admin only.

When paused: `stake` and `fund_rewards` revert.
When paused: `claim` and `unstake` still succeed (exit paths).
function_v0.name: set_paused

function_v0.doc: Actual Zi token balance held by this contract.\nSource of truth for solvency \xe2\x80\x94 use this in the admin panel, not\nany tracked pool counter.
function_v0.name: zi_balance

function_v0.doc: Current reward emission rate (Zi stroops per second).
function_v0.name: reward_rate

function_v0.doc:
Staker position: `(staked_lp, unlock_time, pending_rewards)`.
Frontend reads are simulations and do not persist a TTL extension. The
operations keeper must submit `keep_alive` before the entry reaches its
threshold.
function_v0.name: staker_info

function_v0.doc:
Deposit Zi into the reward pool.  **Admin only.**

Why admin-only: allowing anyone to call `fund_rewards` enables a
griefing attack where the attacker resets the one-year reward window
with a tiny amount, collapsing the reward rate to near-zero.

The `funder` parameter identifies whose Zi is transferred; both the
admin and the funder must authorise so that treasury and operational
keys can be separate accounts or contracts.

Unspent rewards from any in-progress period roll forward into the new
period budget.  The new rate is `total_budget / SECONDS_PER_YEAR`.
The contract does not enforce a 23% APR; it emits whatever rate the
deposited budget can sustain.
function_v0.name: fund_rewards

function_v0.doc: Total LP tokens currently staked across all accounts.
function_v0.name: total_staked

function_v0.doc: Timestamp (seconds) when the current reward period ends.
function_v0.name: period_finish

function_v0.doc: Pending Zi rewards for `staker` at the current ledger timestamp.\nInformational \xe2\x80\x94 uses saturating arithmetic (no state written).
function_v0.name: pending_rewards

function_v0.doc: Replace the Lobstr admin. Both current admins and the replacement must\nauthorize, and the two configured identities must remain distinct.
function_v0.name: transfer_lobstr_admin

function_v0.doc:
Transfer the admin role to `new_admin`.  Both current and new admin
must authorise (prevents accidental transfer to an inaccessible address).

`new_admin` may be a Soroban multisig policy contract for 2-of-3 or
threshold schemes without any custom cryptography in this contract.
function_v0.name: transfer_passkey_admin
